column1: # Truth set for the mutation comparison. Checked against the bundled variants.json by
# chamredb/tests/test_variants.py: for each row, the record found by `query` (in `database`, `taxon`) must have the
# `expected_class` against `other_database`, and, if given, one matched record whose notation contains `expected_match`.
# Every match class appears at least once. Rationale gives why the class is expected; "E. coli numbering" is the
# conventional numbering of the literature. Built against the 2026-11-19 data (CARD 4.0.2, NCBI 2026-10-29.1,
# pointfinder_db 3bd7d5e); a change of class after a data refresh must be explained, not overwritten.
